Illustration: the Sun shines on a field of grain. Orange arrows run from the Sun to the grain, from the grain to bread and from the bread to a cyclist riding on a road: the energy of the motion comes from the Sun.
Kaavakuva: energiaketju Auringosta pyörä: Diagram: the energy chain from the Sun to cycling. The Sun emits radiant energy, the plant (oats) stores it as chemical energy in food, the muscles turn part of it into the motion of the bicycle, and the rest turns into thermal energy. At every step part of the energy is transferred as heat to the surroundings (orange arrows pointing down), and finally the kinetic energy also turns into thermal energy. The lengths of the arrows are not to scale.
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: energia jouleina: Scale diagram: energy in joules on a power-of-ten scale from 1 J to 10 TJ and beyond. Each step is a factor of ten. An apple lifted one metre is about 1 J, a burning match about 1 kJ, a day's food about 10 MJ, a 50-litre petrol tank about 1.6 GJ, and the Olkiluoto 3 nuclear power plant produces about 140 TJ of electricity in a day.
jokainen väli on 10-kertainen: each step is a factor of 10
Kaavakuva mittakaavassa (esimerkki): pyö: Scale diagram (example): of the 800 kJ of chemical energy in the cyclist's morning porridge, the muscles turn 200 kJ into motion and 600 kJ into thermal energy. The width of the arrows is proportional to the energy, and the combined width of the branches equals the width of the original arrow.
nuolen leveys kuvaa energian määrää: the width of the arrow shows the amount of energy
Kuvaaja mittakaavassa: energia jouleina: Graph to scale: energy in joules on a power-of-ten scale from 1 J to 10 TJ. The scale is marked 1 J, 1 kJ, 1 MJ, 1 GJ and 1 TJ, and each small step is a factor of ten. Three points are marked at an order of magnitude: the AA battery is one small step to the right of 1 kJ, boiling a cup of tea water is two small steps to the right of 1 kJ, and lightning is at 1 GJ.
